blockers: CRITICAL: Task 203 (Data Migration Design) is formally BLOCKED. 43,847 records in the GL_ACCOUNTS source table have null values in mandatory S/4HANA fields (cost_centre, profit_centre, account_type). Migration design cannot be finalised until remediation is complete and approved by Finance Director. Estimated unblock date: 21 August 2026 (subject to Finance sign-off completing on schedule).
Task 205 (ETL Pipeline Development) cannot commence as it depends on Task 203. This is now on the critical path.

Finance UAT window (Task 207, planned Q4 2026) is at risk: if migration design slips beyond 28 August, ETL development will not complete in time to support a pre-year-end UAT cycle. A March 2027 go-live is being planned as the primary scenario.
risks: DATA MIGRATION WORKSTREAM — RED: GL_ACCOUNTS data quality issue has moved this workstream to RED status. 3–6 week delay to migration design milestone confirmed. Overall programme critical path impact is 4–8 weeks depending on audit duration and Finance review cycle.

YEAR-END REPORTING CONTINUITY — HIGH: If go-live cannot be achieved before the November 2026 year-end freeze, Finance will operate on legacy ECC through year-end. This is manageable with contingency planning but operationally costly. Finance Director has requested CFO briefing.

GO-LIVE DATE SLIP — HIGH: Based on current trajectory, a pre-year-end go-live (originally planned for Q3 2026) is no longer achievable. March 2027 is the revised primary scenario. Programme Board to be informed.

HISTORICAL PRECEDENT: The 2021 Legacy Payroll Migration experienced analogous data quality issues (null mandatory fields in legacy payroll tables) which caused an 8-week delay. The committee has reviewed lessons from that programme and is applying them: parallel run requirement, Finance oversight of all default mapping, and conservative timeline assumptions.

RESOURCE ADEQUACY: If Finance manual review of 9,600 records takes longer than 2 weeks, the revised 28 August migration design target will slip further. Emma Trent’s team capacity has been ring-fenced; no further contingency buffer available without additional resource.
